prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail deep burgundy hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy deep-purple PVC, made of two small triangle cups each edged with a thin polished chrome ring and held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom by one rigid flat polished chrome bar about one finger wide running straight down the center of her stomach from between the cups to the front of the bottom, with three round chrome rivets set along it, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the bar bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The materials show real behaviour: the polished chrome bar and rivets reflecting sharp bright highlights against her skin, the thin PVC molded so closely that it shows the dip of her navel and her hip bones, fine pull-creases and a deep mirror shine. Pose: reclining on her side on a giant sunflower petal propped on one elbow, her legs stretched out long and crossed at the ankles, the other hand resting on her hip, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme siren bust hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy deep-purple PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy deep-purple PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a sunny summer garden in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic yellow sunflower with petals as long as her whole body fills the frame, a giant fuzzy bee hovering beside it, giant green leaves with veins like roads, a softly blurred garden of flowers far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on a giant sunflower petal with the giant flowers rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright warm sunlight with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous sunflower, bee and leaves around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
